summary: Implemented the endpoint-ruleset builtins helper. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py adds EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum) with the eleven members and values from the spec, each commented with meaning and type. (2) botocore/args.py adds ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults (plus private _compute_sdk_endpoint), imports the enum as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint, and makes _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept endpoint_config=None. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with 23 tests covering every behavioral criterion, with the S3 predicate test asserting one call. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py 58 passed; test_client.py, test_regions.py, test_utils.py 635 passed. Choices: SDK_ENDPOINT is None when absent (key always present); FIPS/DualStack go through the bridge's private lookups _resolve_endpoint_variant_config_var and _resolve_use_dualstack_endpoint. Line length: all added lines are within 79 columns; botocore/args.py:315 (82 columns) is pre-existing and untouched. Nothing committed.
